items.title: DTE Energy's Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Decrease Year Over Year
items.summary: DTE's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates, backed by strong non-utility results, as the company advances infrastructure investments and clean energy plans.

items.title: CenterPoint Energy: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Capital trackers let CenterPoint fund $4 billion in grid expansion while limiting new equity issuance to just $1.6 billion, a financing efficiency that protects existing shareholders.

items.title: Atmos Energy Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: Atmos Energy (NYSE:ATO) is scheduled to report its earnings on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The company has a market value of about $29.4 billion. Over the last twelve months, it generated $4.9 billion in revenue and $1.8 billion in operating profit, with net income of $1.4 billion.

items.title: Entergy Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Increase Year Over Year
items.summary: ETR beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates as strong electricity demand, favorable weather and regulatory rate actions drive growth, while higher costs pressure results.

items.title: PEG Q3 Earnings Miss Expectations, Revenues Decrease Y/Y
items.summary: PEG's Q3 2026 earnings and revenues miss estimates amid declining operating income and rising costs despite higher sales volumes and nuclear generation.

items.title: Dominion Energy's Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: D's Q3 earnings rise 20.8% and beat estimates by 6.7%, while revenues increase 24.1% and surpass expectations by 17%, driven by strong utility performance.

items.title: Edison International Q3 Earnings Outpace Estimates, Revenues Miss
items.summary: EIX's Q3 earnings decline 17.9% but beat estimates by 4.9%, while revenues fall 15% and miss expectations by 11.7%.

items.title: IDACORP Q3 Earnings & Revenues Outpace Estimates, '26 EPS View Raised
